title: Unnamed fortification near Bousâada, Algeria
description: Remains of an ancient fortification recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within a kilometer of the BAtlas coordinates: a point east-northeast of modern Bousâada in the municipal territory of modern At Muḥli/Beni Mouhli in Algeria's Setif province.

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
properties.title: BAtlas Point Location
